questions.questionText: In which city was Prophet Muhammad born?
questions.explanation: The Prophet was born in Makkah.

questions.questionText: To which tribe did Prophet Muhammad belong?
questions.explanation: He belonged to Quraysh, specifically Banu Hashim.

questions.questionText: What was the name of the Prophet's father?
questions.explanation: His father was Abdullah ibn Abdul Muttalib.

questions.questionText: What was the name of the Prophet's mother?
questions.explanation: His mother was Aminah bint Wahb.

questions.questionText: Who cared for him after his mother passed away?
questions.explanation: His grandfather Abdul Muttalib cared for him after his mother's death.

questions.questionText: Who became his guardian after his grandfather died?
questions.explanation: His uncle Abu Talib became his guardian.

questions.questionText: Who was the first wife of Prophet Muhammad?
questions.explanation: Khadijah bint Khuwaylid was his first wife.

questions.questionText: How old was Prophet Muhammad when revelation began?
questions.explanation: Sahih al-Bukhari reports that revelation began when he was forty.

questions.questionText: Where was the Prophet when he received the first revelation?
questions.explanation: The first revelation came in the Cave of Hira.

questions.questionText: Who first comforted and supported him after the first revelation?
questions.explanation: Khadijah comforted him and affirmed her support.

questions.questionText: Who accompanied the Prophet during the Hijrah?
questions.explanation: Abu Bakr accompanied him during the migration.

questions.questionText: Who stayed behind in Mecca, sleeping in the Prophet's bed to distract the assassins before following later?
questions.explanation: The Prophet asked Ali to lie in his bed, to deceive the Quraysh assassins who surrounded his house in Makkah.

questions.questionText: In which cave did they shelter during the Hijrah?
questions.explanation: They sheltered in the Cave of Thawr.

questions.questionText: Where did the Prophet migrate from Makkah?
questions.explanation: He migrated to Madinah, then known as Yathrib.

questions.questionText: What was the first major battle between the Muslims and Quraysh?
questions.explanation: The Battle of Badr took place in 2 AH.

questions.questionText: After how many years did the Prophet die, after the Hijrah?
questions.explanation: He died 10 years after the Hijrah. He stayed those 10 years in Madinah.

questions.questionText: Who became the first caliph after the Prophet?
questions.explanation: Abu Bakr was the first caliph.

questions.questionText: Which companion married two of Prophet's daughters?
questions.explanation: Uthman ibn Affan married two of the Prophet's daughters. He first married Ruqayyah bint Muhammad; and after her death, he married Umm Kulthum bint Muhammad

questions.questionText: Which companion was the Prophet's cousin and son-in-law?
questions.explanation: Ali was the Prophet's cousin and married his daughter Fatimah.

questions.questionText: Which treaty was agreed between Muslims and Quraysh in 6 AH?
questions.explanation: The Treaty of Hudaybiyyah was concluded in 6 AH.

questions.questionText: How old was Prophet Muhammad when he passed away, according to authentic narrations?
questions.explanation: Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim report that he died at age 63.

questions.questionText: How many wives did Prophet Muhammad have?
questions.explanation: Prophet Muhammad had a total of 11 wives.

questions.questionText: For how many years did Prophet Muhammad stay in Makkah after the first revelation?
questions.explanation: The Prophet spent thirteen years in Makkah after the first revelation and then he had to move to Madinah.

questions.questionText: What were the names of the sons of Prophet Muhammad?
questions.explanation: He had 3 sons: Qasim, Abdullah & Ibrahim. 1st two were born in Makkah, and Ibrahim was born in Madinah

questions.questionText: Who was the first daughter of Prophet Muhammad?
questions.explanation: Zainab was the eldest daughter meanwhile Fatimah was the youngest.

questions.questionText: Who was the first child of Prophet Muhammad?
questions.explanation: Qasim was his first child and hence his kunya: Abu Al-Qasim.

questions.questionText: Prophet Muhammad belonged to Quraysh.
questions.explanation: He belonged to Quraysh, from Banu Hashim.

questions.questionText: His father was alive when he was born.
questions.explanation: His father Abdullah died before his birth.

questions.questionText: Abu Talib cared for him after his grandfather died.
questions.explanation: Abu Talib became his guardian.

questions.questionText: Khadijah رضي الله عنها was his first wife.
questions.explanation: Khadijah was his first wife.

questions.questionText: The first revelation came in the Cave of Thawr.
questions.explanation: It came in the Cave of Hira; Thawr was used during the Hijrah.

questions.questionText: Abu Bakr رضي الله عنه accompanied the Prophet during Hijrah.
questions.explanation: Abu Bakr was his companion on the migration.

questions.questionText: The Battle of Badr took place before the Hijrah.
questions.explanation: Badr took place in 2 AH, after the Hijrah.

questions.questionText: The Treaty of Hudaybiyyah was concluded in 6 AH.
questions.explanation: The treaty was agreed in the sixth year after Hijrah.

questions.questionText: The Prophet passed away at age 73 according to authentic narrations.
questions.explanation: Authentic narrations report that he passed away at age 63.

questions.questionText: The Prophet had no sons.
questions.explanation: He had 3 sons - but by the Will of Allah, they all died very young.

questions.questionText: The Prophet had 4 daughters.
questions.explanation: He had 4 daughters - Zaynab, Ruqayyah, Umm Kulthum & Fatima.

questions.questionText: The Prophet did not marry any women, until after the death of his first wife Khadijah.
questions.explanation: He only married after the death of Khadijah bint Khuwaylid.
